d: Indonesia’s stock market has suffered its biggest one-day crash since the Asian financial crisis of 1998, wiping out around $65 billion in market value. In this video, Firstpost examines how MSCI’s threat to downgrade Indonesia from an emerging market to a standalone market has rattled investors and could trigger billions of dollars in capital outflows. The video looks at concerns over market transparency, concentrated share ownership and the enforcement of reforms. It also examines the wider economic pressures facing President Prabowo Subianto, from rising living costs and fuel shortages…
